plan: known issues carried out of the agent-dx plan

phases.name: every application file is listed in some wiki page's code_refs
phases.note: wiki:audit reports undocumented files without blocking, on purpose: blocking it buys one-line pages written to clear a gate. 2026-11-18: the 117 files it listed were documented on their existing area pages via /document, no new pages. The 19 nested AGENTS.md files under app/ stay listed; they are generated by agents:context and excluded here.

phases.name: local coverage run measures a subset because TIA narrows it
phases.note: pest()->tia()->locally() in tests/Pest.php restricts the run to affected files, so --coverage --exactly=100.0 reports 99.1 % locally and passes in CI, where TIA is off. 2026-11-18: the command above exits 0, 2028/2028 tests at Total 100.0 %.

phases.name: app:doctor reports the coverage driver as FAIL under Herd
phases.note: Xdebug is not loaded by default under Herd. 2026-11-18: with Xdebug loaded through php.ini (xdebug.mode=off, the line SETUP.md gives) and a queue worker running, app:doctor exits 0 and reports Coverage driver PASS; the check's fix line points at that SETUP.md section.

phases.name: bun audit ignores GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf (picomatch ReDoS) because no fixed release exists
phases.note: Added 2026-11-18. picomatch <=4.0.7 is flagged and 4.0.7 is the latest release, so there is nothing to upgrade to. It arrives through build tooling (knip, shadcn, vite-plus, laravel-vite-plugin, @inertiajs/vite, @rolldown/plugin-babel) and matches globs the repo writes, not request input. composer.json test:audit passes --ignore for this one advisory. Remove the flag when a fixed picomatch ships.

phases.name: GitHub branch ruleset 26004808 requires the current CI check names: verify, secrets, semgrep, a11y
phases.note: 2026-11-18: required_status_checks replaced (was setup, tests, security, docs, static, a11y, analyze (actions), analyze (javascript-typescript), scan). deletion and non_fast_forward rules and both bypass actors kept. The names are the ci.yml job ids, which have no name: override; no check-run has reported them yet because CI is deferred.
